description.value: The Kitsilano Branch of the Vancouver Public Library serves one of Vancouver's most cycling-friendly neighbourhoods, sitting close to the Arbutus Greenway and the beaches of English Bay. As a public library, it offers a quiet, free indoor space where touring cyclists can rest, connect, and recharge. It is operated by the Vancouver Public Library system, one of the busiest public library systems in Canada.
